english.title: Deface / damage notice board on railway
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..)

(A)_[pulled down]_
(B)_[injured]_
(C)_[obliterated the letters or figures on]_

a board at **(..SPECIFY LOCATION..) put or affixed for the purpose of publishing

(D)_[byelaws of the **(..SPECIFY THE COMPANY..)]_
(E)_[any penalty imposed by **(..SPECIFY THE ACT..)]_
english.legislation: Contrary to section 144 of the Railway Clauses Consolidation Act 1845.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
pulled down/injured/obliterated the letters/figures on a board
put/affixed for the purposes of publishing byelaws/any penalty

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In Scotland this offence contravenes Section 136 of the Railway Clauses Consolidation Act 1845.)
(ii) A 'special Act' means any Act of Parliament passed after 1845 which authorises the construction of a railway and incorporates the Railway Clauses Consolidation Act 1845.
